notes: A new, easier editor for pages moved with their own look. Press any part and drag it: pink lines line it up with the parts around it. Drag a corner to resize. Double-click words to type. A style panel changes text size, bold, alignment, colours (from your site's own colours), background, corners, spacing, shadow and opacity. Arrow keys nudge, Delete removes, Ctrl+Z undoes and Ctrl+D repeats.
